description: AI & privacy gateway: which data classes (public, internal, personal, sensitive) from connected products (VerAIn, BookAIze, ERNTEapp, TaufNaus, SupportAIze …) may reach an AI model, as none (removed), pseudonymised (stable token per run/session, re-identified only for the human and for tool arguments within 24 h) or allowed — per tenant and optionally per product. Also the field catalogue that maps response fields to classes and the fixed rules (IBAN never in clear, ids unchanged). Readable by every member of the tenant.
name: ai_privacy_rules
